summary: 21-year-old woman volunteering with the Nature Conservancy marking plants fell ~50 ft down a cliff near Andrews Park Road, ~1.25 mi north of mile marker 5.5 on West County Road 80C; she landed on a ledge, likely preventing a further ~400-ft fall into the North Fork of the Poudre River. LCSO Emergency Services and Larimer County SAR assisted Livermore Fire Protection District, Poudre Valley Ambulance and Air Link; rescuers roped down to her, secured her, and rigged a vertical rope system to lift her up the cliff; she was carried to an ambulance ~4:50 p.m. with serious but non-life-threatening injuries and transported to a local hospital.
location: Andrews Park Road, ~1.25 mi N of MM 5.5 on West County Road 80C, north of Livermore
responding_agency: Larimer County Sheriff's Office Emergency Services; Larimer County Search and Rescue; Livermore Fire Protection District; Poudre Valley Ambulance; Air Link
